data.title: Network situation (Week 40: 28 September - 4 October)
data.content:
Traffic

There were 34,421 daily flights in W40, -2.4% less than in W39. This is 3% higher than in 2025 and 105% of 2019 levels.

ATFM Delay

ATFM delay was 2.7 min/flight (1.8 en-route / 1.0 airport) on W40, 32% higher than in W39.

For en-route ATFM delay:

  • Barcelona ACC recorded weather delays every day, alongside ATC capacity delays throughout the week.
  • Marseille ACC faced daily ATC capacity and staffing delays, with additional weather delays, particularly high on Sunday. Several sectors were regulated on Tuesday due to ATC Industrial Action.
  • Makedonia ACC was impacted by staffing delays throughout the week, with significant weather delays on Wednesday and ATC capacity delays on Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday (traffic +7% vs 2025).
  • Reims ACC faced ATC capacity and staffing delays throughout the week. Significant weather delays were recorded on Wednesday.
  • Madrid ACC was impacted by ATC capacity delays throughout the week, with additional weather delays every day except Tuesday. Military exercises also contributed to delays from Monday to Friday.

For airport ATFM delay:

  • Barcelona was affected by convective weather activity (CB) and thunderstorms (TS) throughout the week, resulting in daily weather-related regulations and significant delays on Tuesday and Thursday.
  • Tel Aviv continues to experience a daily combination of aerodrome and ATC capacity regulations, with the highest delays on Wednesday.
  • Athens saw daily aerodrome capacity regulations due to work in progress (WIP) at the airport.
  • Palma de Mallorca suffered from recurrent convective activity (CB) and thunderstorms (TS) throughout the week, resulting in daily weather-related regulations and significant delays on Saturday.
  • London Heathrow saw multifactor of aerodrome capacity and weather regulations due to low visibility procedures (LVP) and strong winds.

Punctuality

In W40 arrival punctuality decreased to 75%, -2pp worse than in W39.
